---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible runtime issue
---

Describe the task, expected behavior and actual behavior. Include Forge/Python/OS versions, the command, provider name and a minimal reproduction with a fake provider where possible. State whether the workspace was dirty and whether exploration was used.

Do not attach API keys, raw environment dumps, private code or unreviewed `.forge` evidence. Report vulnerabilities privately as described in SECURITY.md.
